hypothesis_text: Reducing BGE-M3 retrieval chunk size from 512 to 256 tokens improves needle-in-haystack recall by 4-7% on academic-paper corpora.
prior_art_summary: Retrieval chunking trade-offs are extensively studied (LangChain / LlamaIndex docs; numerous RAG papers 2023-2025). Smaller chunks improving recall on dense queries is the standard finding.
rationale: Confirms well-known RAG trade-off with specific numbers on a specific corpus. Low-mid novelty.
